title: Polynomial generic strict localization is a separably closed field
statement: Let K:Type u be an algebraically closed field, m a natural number, B=Spec K[x_0,...,x_(m-1)], b:B->Spec K its structure map, and s:Spec Omega->B a geometric point with Omega:Type u algebraically closed. Use the strict localization B_(s) and its structural morphism from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Let residueFieldTrdeg b y denote the canonical residue transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. If m<=trdeg_K kappa(s), as a cardinal inequality, then there is a u-small separably closed field L and a scheme isomorphism B_(s) ~= Spec L. This includes m=0.

proof.text: Polynomial affine space is smooth and integral of dimension m: use the polynomial smoothness instances, HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff, PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim, MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing and ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field. By [lem-kun-finite-type-residue-trdeg], the residue transcendence degree is a finite natural number a. The existing private theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residueFieldHomOfOver_eq from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.AffineLineInfinityStrictLocalModel, reused through a proof-only import all, identifies the scalar map in residueFieldTrdeg with b.residueFieldAlgebraMap by germ naturality. Thus the hypothesis gives m <= a.

Give kappa(y) its canonical K-algebra structure and give Omega its kappa(y)-algebra structure from SpecToEquivOfField. The inverse-equivalence equation proves their geometric factorization. Construct the K-algebra map into R using Spec.preimage of the structural composite; Spec.map_preimage proves its compatibility. Apply [lem-sc-smooth-strict-local-field-model-core] to obtain a local integral domain R of dimension m-a and an equivalence from its residue field to separableClosure(kappa(y),Omega). Since m <= a, its dimension is zero. No coefficient field or function-field conclusion is used.

Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isReduced makes R a field. The residue map is injective as a map from a field and surjective by IsLocalRing.residue_surjective. RingEquiv.ofBijective therefore identifies R with its residue field; compose with the equivalence from the core to L=separableClosure(kappa(y),Omega). IsSepClosure.sep_closed supplies separable closedness of L, and Scheme.Spec.mapIso applied contravariantly to this ring equivalence gives the claimed scheme isomorphism. The same dimension computation includes m=0.

proof_origin.place: Exceptional generic degree-two case; use the smooth strict-local core and the zero-dimensional residue-field equivalence, without coefficient-field construction.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_generic_strictLocalization_field
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (m : ℕ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin m) K)))
    (hs : (m : Cardinal.{u}) ≤ residueFieldTrdeg
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin m) K))))
      (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : IsSepClosed L),
      Nonempty (strictHenselizationScheme s ≅ Spec (.of L))
